description: Get the dilution snapshot header (the heaviest dilution call): summary totals (potential new shares and their percentage of shares outstanding, per-family share totals), the cash position (anchor cash, monthly burn, estimated current cash, runway months), the float block, and `meta` provenance. Cash amounts are in the filer's REPORTING currency, not always USD: read `cashPosition.currency` (ISO 4217; null = not determined) and `cashPosition.currencySource` ("presumed_usd" = no foreign marker found, not a measurement) before calling a figure dollars. Runway months are currency-neutral. DOES NOT INCLUDE INSTRUMENT ROWS — call get_dilution_instruments per family for those, and call get_dilution_coverage first to avoid a wasted call on an uncovered ticker. 🔴 FLOAT: a declined float block (`available: false`) carries the read tier's `reason` and, when the extraction recorded a veto, a `refusal` object whose `withheldReason` is the exact value get_float serves — read that, not the bare reason, when reconciling the two. 🔴 FLOAT: when `floatWithheldReason` is non-null the tradeable float was NOT MEASURED and must not be stated as a number. `tradeableFloatCeiling` is an UPPER BOUND ("at most X"), NOT a float — never feed it to a market capitalisation, a percent-of-float, a short-interest ratio or a comparison; say in words that the float is at most that figure (a bound) — never print it as a bare number and never with a ~ / ≤ / ≥ glyph (2026-10-18). 🔴 BOUNDED TOTALS: a null share total (`potentialNewShares`, `totalWarrantShares`, `totalConvertibleShares`, `totalEquityPlanShares`, `totalExchangeableShares`, and `potentialDilutionPercent`) may sit beside `<key>Bound: "ceiling"`, `<key>Ceiling` and `<key>Floor`: some rows could not be placed on one split basis, but they can add at most a provably small amount. Report the ceiling as "at most X" and the floor as the measured part — NEVER the ceiling as the measured total, and never feed it to a ratio or comparison as if measured. The null key itself still means not measured. 🔴 RUNWAY: a runway figure beside `goingConcern: true` is a contradiction the issuer's own auditors have flagged — report both, never the runway alone. ALWAYS RETURNS 200 — read `available` and `reason`, never the HTTP status. Coverage is partial: `not_covered` means THIS COMPANY HAS NOT BEEN ANALYSED YET, which is different from it having no dilution and different from an outage (an outage is a 5xx). Never report a company as having no dilution on the strength of an unavailable response. NULL, absent or withheld means NOT MEASURED — it NEVER means "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a MEASURED zero and defeats a null check, so decide from the accompanying availability/withheld/reason field, never from the value itself. If a figure is absent, say it was not measured; do not describe the company as having none of that instrument. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` — a stale as-of date means the answer predates anything filed since, not that nothing has happened. Share counts are rebased onto a single split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted rather than published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro — without it the call returns 403 with code FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE and `requiredTier: "pro"`. That is a subscription-tier upgrade, not an add-on purchase; there is no separate add-on to buy.
name: get_dilution_snapshot
title: Get Dilution Snapshot Summary
